clause_decisions.reason: The complete section includes establishment, ordinary membership and invited temporary federal heads. The1967 and1979 restatements continue the clause under the owner ruling. P.L.93-644 expressly carries OEO references to CSA from1975-01-04; P.L.96-88 and EO12212 carry the HEW chair to HHS from1980-05-04, subject to education-transfer scope. The1981 CSA repeal is recorded as a seat issue, without inventing an OCS substitution or whole-Council end. EO12379 expressly revokes the parent as amended.

All study, coordination, information-sharing and annual-report commands are inventoried; revocation supports absence of continuing EO authority at cutoff, while first cessation and prior performance remain open.
Both assistance/cooperation provisions are inventoried. Formal revocation reaches their continuing EO authority, while liabilities and independent statutory obligations are reserved.

The original expressly executes abolition of the1959 Federal Council and supersession of its letter. The genuine record preserves this independent action and its unresolved residual/first-end treatment. Its terminated label is not read as revival of the old Council or erasure of the executed act.

FACA section3(2) and14-15 official pages visually checked. The full known rosters, including1979, consist of full-time federal agency heads; invited temporary heads under1(c) do too. The statutory exclusion defeats a mechanical two-year sunset for this Council; no full FACA exhaustion claim is made.
